services.name: Garage Rental
services.desc: For single day rentals, garages will be unlocked for move-in at 7:00am and will be closed and locked at 7:00pm. For multi-day events, should you rent a garage for consecutive days, you may leave equipment inside the garage overnight. Each morning the garages will be opened at 7:00am and locked at 10:00pm. Rental is only valid for these time frames. Garage bays ARE assigned. Please check in at the wavier booth upon entering the facility to receive your garage number.
